source.publication: 2025 Kentucky Form 740 packet with instructions (Kentucky Department of Revenue), with 2025 Form 740, Schedule M, Schedule P and Schedule ITC
source.section: Form 740 (2025) page 1 lines 5-19 and page 2 lines 20-22 (740_2025.pdf PDF pp.1-2); packet PDF p.13 Line 5, Lines 6-9 (Kentucky AGI), Line 10 'Nonitemizers, enter the standard deduction of $3,270 ... If filing a joint return, only one $3,270 standard deduction is allowed', Line 11, Line 12 'Multiply line 11 by four percent (.04)'; packet PDF p.3 'For 2025, the standard deduction is $3,270' and 'the tax rate for individual income tax is 4%'; Schedule ITC (2025) PDF p.2 Section B line 1 (taxpayer) and line 5 (spouse) 'If you were 65 on or before 12/31/2025, enter 40'; Form 740 lines 16-18 (line 18: if line 17 is larger than line 16, enter zero); packet PDF p.14 Line 17; Schedule ITC (2025) PDF p.2 Section C Family Size Tax Credit Table (family size one: not over 15,650 100% ... over 20,815 0; family size two: not over 21,150 100% ... over 28,130 0); packet PDF p.26 Worksheet for Computation of Modified Gross Income lines (a)-(j) and Section C family size definitions; packet PDF p.11 Modified Gross Income; packet PDF p.14 Line 20 and Line 21 (MGI 42,760 or less); Form 740 page 2 lines 20-22 (line 21: line 19 times the decimal from Schedule ITC)

worked: Married filing jointly, person 0 is 66 with no income, person 1 is 63 with wages 45,000. Only person 0 was 65 on or before 12/31/2025, so Section B gives one 40 (line 1 for the taxpayer; line 5 for the spouse is 0). Only one spouse had income, so Filing Status 2 is not open and the joint return's one 3,270 is the form's own result. Federal (given, not tested): federal AGI = wages (person 1) 45,000.00 = 45,000.00. Federal taxable income = 45,000.00 - standard deduction 31,500.00 - 1 x 1,600.00 for 65 or older = 11,900.00 (federal senior deduction ignored). Form 740, Filing Status 3 (married, filing joint return; incomes added in Column B). Line 5 federal AGI 45,000.00. Line 6 additions 0.00; line 7 = 45,000.00. Schedule M line 17 total subtractions 0.00; Form 740 line 8 0.00. Line 9 Kentucky AGI = 45,000.00 - 0.00 = 45,000.00. Line 10 standard deduction 3,270.00 (one deduction on a joint return); line 11 taxable income = 45,000.00 - 3,270.00 = 41,730.00. Line 12 tax = 41,730.00 x 0.04 = 1,669.20; lines 13 and 15 0.00; line 14 and line 16 1,669.20. Schedule ITC Section B: person 0 (age 66) 40; under-65 persons 0; line 17 = 40.00; line 18 = 1,669.20 - 40.00 = 1,629.20. Line 19 = 1,629.20. Modified gross income worksheet: (a) 45,000.00; (c) non-Kentucky municipal interest 0.00; (e) 45,000.00; (f) Kentucky AGI 45,000.00; (i) 45,000.00; (j) greater = 45,000.00. MGI 45,000.00 is over 42,760: no Family Size Tax Credit; line 21 0.00. Line 22 = 1,629.20 - 0.00 = 1,629.20. Credits = 40.00 + 0.00 = 40.00; state income tax 1,629.20. The form enters whole dollars; expected keeps the formula result to the cent.
